_comment: Hand edits applied on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Karlstad C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). Three floors: the Trädgårdslänken footbridge at the east end (1), street, station house and platforms (0) and the pedestrian tunnel at the west end of the station house (-1), from OSM's layers. OSM splits platform 1 into 1b (west), an unnumbered middle piece and 1a (east), and the island into 3a/3b and 4a/4b; they are merged into platforms 1, 3 and 4, because Trafikverket announces 1a/1b/3a/... and the app matches on the base track. Track 21 is the north face of the west end of platform 1 (Trafikverket uses it; seen on the live board 2026-10-22). NOT CHECKED AGAINST A STATION PLAN: the owner's Värmlandstrafik image isn't available as a file, so the tunnel and footbridge stairs and lifts are as OSM maps them (no hand connections were needed). OSM's escalator from platform 1 into the tunnel (way 1483484348) is tagged access=no and stays out. OSM maps the tunnel lifts twice (a lift node and a lift outline 2 m apart), so two lift edges show at each; harmless for routing.

sources.note: Jernhusen: the station's one kiosk is Pressbyrån (matches OSM's kiosk on platform 1); one accessible toilet, card payment (OSM: 10 SEK, cards). Lockers are mentioned but no source places them.
Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000070).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (2026-10-19 extract): platform pieces merged into 1, 3, 4 and 21; Pressbyrån's kiosk kept with its outline; checked against Jernhusen's pages (2026-10-22). Not checked against a station plan.
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 18 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000070).
